BiblicalUsage: This word is dismay, sheer terror, and Job throws it at his friends when they see his casting down and are afraid. They came to comfort and ended up dismayed by what they saw.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Job names something true about suffering: it dismays even the friends, and only God is not frightened by it.
